lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I have a question.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Are you busy right now?
Nope, I'm not.
Go ahead and ask.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Hehe, thank you!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: This might be a random question,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: but how does it feel when you ride the AZX, Commander?
It was good.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Oh my, hehe! I see.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Which part did you enjoy the most?
I like the comfy seats.
I like the great service.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Right? Hehe!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: The comfy seats

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: are one of the AZX's highlights!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Right? Hehe!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: The friendly service

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: is one of the AZX's highlights!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Then, was there anything you felt could have been better?
There was.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Could you tell me what it was?
I got a little bored since there wasn't anything fun going on.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Oh my, really?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Thank you for your valuable feedback, hehe!
Why are you asking this out of the blue?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Oh, hehe! Actually,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: we've been conducting a survey with the passengers lately

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: about topics like,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: what they enjoy when riding the AZX

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: and

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: what they feel could be improved.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Since you're one of AZX's valued passengers,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I really wanted to hear your thoughts, hehe!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: But it seems everyone feels pretty much the same...

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Many shared opinions similar to yours.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: So we'll gather them all,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: make the things you love even better,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: and work on the parts that need improvement. Hehehe!
You always put your passengers first.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: The AZX is a train that brings happiness to its passengers, after all!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Since you've also participated in the survey,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I'll be sending you a little gift!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Please look forward to it, hehe!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Thank you for today!
